name: Flaçà (Spain)
description: Vertical bicolour of light blue and white, charged at the centre with a mitre counterchanged.
history: The flag was approved by the municipal council of Flaçà on 30 May 2002 and published in the Diari Oficial de la Generalitat de Catalunya no. 3690 of 1 August 2002; it is an oblong flag of 2:3, vertical bicolour light blue and white, with a mitre 2/3 of the height at the centre, white on the first half.

features.role: mitre 2/3 of the height counterchanged, white on the blue and blue on the white
